leads.name: EUCALIPTUS DE SA BASTIDA
leads.note: Register lists ownership as Publica CAIB, Alaro, but independent web search described it as standing on a private property near the old Sa Bastida fountain orchard, and gave a modest age (75-100 years, not remarkable for the species). Ownership conflict not resolved this pass; register page URL guessed incorrectly and not refetched. Needs a direct register page fetch and an access check before it can ship.

leads.name: PLATANERS DE S ESCORXADOR
leads.note: Ensemble of 6 plane trees, Alaro, Publica AJUNTAMENT D ALARO, at the old municipal slaughterhouse (s escorxador). Not chased this pass; worth checking whether it reads as one compact collectible ensemble (a plaza/courtyard) under the ensemble rule.

leads.name: PINS DE PLANICIA
leads.note: Ensemble register entry, Banyalbufar, Publica CAIB, originally 4 pines, register already records 2 dead of 4. Not chased this pass; would need current-status check on the surviving two before publishing as an ensemble.

leads.name: ALADERNS DE MINER
leads.note: Ensemble of 6 Phyllirea latifolia, Escorca, Publica CAIB. Not chased this pass, unusual/obscure species for a lead page.

leads.name: ARAUCARIES DE LA PUNTA
leads.note: Ensemble of 2 Araucaria heterophylla, Pollenca, Publica CIMa, on the road near Es Moll / towards Formentor. Not chased this pass beyond a first search; worth a dedicated look given the Pollenca/Formentor day-trip appeal CLAUDE.md flags for this island.

leads.name: ELS ESTANCA-SANGS
leads.note: Register entry (not a single tree; 3 ash trees originally catalogued, register already records 2 dead of 3), Santa Maria del Cami, Publica CIMA. Not chased this pass; the one survivor would need its own current-status check.

leads.name: PLATER DE LA FONT DE VALELLA
leads.note: Plane tree at a public fountain/spring in Selva. Register page URL could not be found this pass (guessed URLs 404d); ajselva.net has a PDF (fontsdecamarataidevalella.pdf) about the fountains that was not fetched. Looks like a solid public-fountain candidate for a future pass.

blocked.name: LLEDONER DE SOR CLARA ANDREU
blocked.reason: access uncertain. Register id 431, stands in the cloister of the Jeronimas convent (Monestir de Sant Bartomeu, Inca), which has been a cloistered (clausura) community since 1534. Only access mention found is a 2013 newspaper snippet about a monthly (last Thursday) exhibition opening, not confirmed current. Two good sources exist for the tree itself (CAIB register, es.wikipedia), so if a current, reliable access confirmation turns up this is otherwise publishable.
